meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 你给出一段时间范围后,它会读取本地 screenpipe 记录的屏幕活动,聚类出重复的工作流程,对照仓库里已有的技能,产出可审阅的新技能草稿或组合配方。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近的工作并据此提出技能时触发。需本地 screenpipe 守护进程在 3030 端口运行,否则它会拒绝执行。

howto.what_en: Given a time window, it reads screen activity captured by the local screenpipe daemon, clusters repeated workflows, compares them against existing skills, and drafts reviewable new-skill or composition-recipe proposals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze your recent work and propose skills from it. Requires the local screenpipe daemon running on port 3030; it refuses to run if unreachable.
